load_image_processor: load an image processor from a pretrained model name or path using AutoImageProcessor.from_pretrained
resolve_image_processor_backend: resolve the image processing backend to torchvision or pil based on model type and availability
register_image_processor: register a custom image processor class for a model config in the auto mapping
get_image_processor_config: load the image processor configuration dict from a pretrained model directory or hub path
get_image_processor_class_from_name: resolve an image processor class name to its class object by name lookup
